heuristics: Smoothness probabilities, relation counts and the factor-base size use Dickman's rho with the GS21 alpha correction, as estimated by the GS21 simulator; this is the standard heuristic basis of NFS analyses.

Relation collection is charged ln(ln B) cycles per enumerated tuple, calibrated on record NFS computations by BD19 and GS21; the worst measured STNFS data point (GGMT17, about 27 cycles/tuple = 7.08 cycles per model operation) needs at most 57 instructions per model operation at the 8-wide retirement limit, and the 128-instruction charge leaves 1.25x the sieving requirement for the omitted phases.

The individual-logarithm descent and ECM cofactorization are subdominant as stated by GS21 and BP14; the ledger additionally charges 1.25x the worst-case sieving work for them, for failed relations and retries, filtering, final verification and output.
The matrix weight (200), filtering factor (20) and block-Wiedemann word cost are GS21's modeling choices; moderate deviations are absorbed by the 1.25x omitted-phase allowance.
limitations: The total is an analytic upper bound in the published STNFS cost model, not a theorem and not a production-size execution; no attack was run at BLS12-381 scale.

A 2023 survey applying the Barbulescu-Duquesne model reports a lower BLS12-381 figure (2^122.54), but it is not reproducible from its stated parameters (its 2^122.85 sieving space already exceeds the reported total, and its factor-base count is inconsistent); the submission uses the self-consistent GS21 2^126.15, the conservative choice.
Peak storage of about 2^72.4 bytes is analytically justified but astronomically large; memory is supplementary in this track.
Preprocessing (relation collection and linear algebra) is charged in full to this instance under the no-amortization rule; no benefit from hypothetical future instances is taken.

The measured c_sieve constant is from a dimension-three STNFS record; applying it to the dimension-twelve BLS12-381 lattice is an extrapolation, covered by the 1.25x omitted-phase allowance and the 2.25x total-to-worst-record ratio.
The 8 instructions/cycle retirement-width bound and the 16x sieving/omitted-phase factor are conservative bookkeeping conventions, not measurements of a specific binary.
The reduction is to the GT discrete logarithm with base e(P,Q0); no auxiliary powers are used and P is never replaced.
